No app on this device can open web links

Lets an agent running on your computer act on this phone: shell commands, files, screenshots, taps, apps. It listens on your local network while the switch is on, and every request needs the token below.
Off. Nothing is listening; the agent cannot reach this phone.
Copied. Paste it into your agent\'s environment.

Auto picks the best this phone allows. Root runs commands as root; Shizuku runs them as the shell user (adb level, no root); app only runs them as this app, which cannot use input, pm or settings. Start with Auto and press Test.
Running as %1$s. Accessibility is on, so taps, the UI tree and screenshots work.
Running as %1$s. Accessibility is off: taps, the UI tree and screenshots need it on a phone without root.
New token generated. Update your agent, the old one no longer works.
Full steps for root, Shizuku and app-only access are in docs/DEVICE-CONTROL.md in the app\'s repository.

Lets the device-control bridge read the screen and send taps, swipes and text when asked by your own agent. Nothing is recorded and no screen content leaves the phone except in a screenshot you request.
Shown while this phone can be controlled over your network.
Enter the address of your Hermes web app: a machine on your network, or the public URL you use.
Private addresses are opened over http, public ones over https. Add the port if your server needs one.
That is not an address the app can open. Try 192.168.1.20:9120 or https://example.com
